gen-gf-comic-relief-gf-tajawal: Tajawal reads smooth and unfussy, its c shaped like a broad hook. Comic Relief up top has no calligraphic swell at all, so the lines look drawn with one marker, and the sans-serif text beneath feels like a quiet reply.
gen-gf-comic-relief-gf-tasa-explorer: TASA Explorer is friendly sans-serif, its curves ending like brush strokes lifted early. Comic Relief earns its place big and short, where those bowls left open on one side and that thread-thin, unswollen line get noticed.
gen-gf-comic-relief-gf-tasa-orbiter: TASA Orbiter reads crisp, with no small counter clogged. Comic Relief does its best work with a flat, stencil-cut punch from single-weight strokes, while the sans below simply keeps tiny shapes open and legible.
gen-gf-comic-relief-gf-teachers: Teachers reads modern and light, like thin steel rod bent into letters. Over a full page, Teachers has ink strokes that taper out before touching, which loosens up the blunt Comic Relief heading sitting above it.
gen-gf-comic-relief-gf-telex: Approachable energy comes from the body, where curvy letters feel unclamped. Telex then lets Comic Relief glow like tube-shaped neon glass above it, the sans-serif text staying out of the way.
gen-gf-comic-relief-gf-tenor-sans: Tenor Sans keeps its c tips from ever creeping toward touching, with light but visible stroke variation. Yet Comic Relief has no hairlines or shadows at all, and that flat, bold heading against the modest thick-thin text is what makes the pair.
gen-gf-comic-relief-gf-tirra: Tirra draws round forms that look like open parentheses. Comic Relief has no pinched joints or flared ends, so beside the sans-serif text it feels blunt and cheerful, each one making the other's softness stand out.
gen-gf-comic-relief-gf-titillium-web: Titillium Web feels contemporary and approachable, with stroke ends set far apart. Comic Relief is best at bold, modulation-free headings, while Titillium Web does its best work carrying steady sans text underneath.
gen-gf-comic-relief-gf-tomorrow: Tomorrow reads clean, its bowls opening like a cupped palm of clay. Tomorrow also meets Comic Relief, whose tails and terminals are as thick as its stems, so the heavy top and lighter sans below feel like loud and quiet neighbors.
gen-gf-comic-relief-gf-trispace: Trispace spreads sparse, widely set letters, with curves that open outward instead of curling in. Comic Relief is best at uppercase built from lines of constant thickness, while Trispace is best at relaxed, approachable sans text.
